{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for the 6 QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = data[data['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f'Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}')

# Convert revenue from string to float after removing commas
# First, confirm the format: some entries have commas, others don't
print(data['revenue'].unique()[:10])  # Show first 10 unique values

data['revenue_numeric'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for any invalid values
invalid_revenue = data['revenue_numeric'].isna().sum()
print(f'Invalid revenue values: {invalid_revenue}')"}
